done_when: When archiving a recorded Codex conversation fails, forge merge still finishes its tidy-up (branch, worktree, records), prints which conversations it could not archive and that they can be archived later, and exits successfully; a test through forge merge with a stub that refuses archiving shows it
why: forge merge stops before tidying up when Codex refuses to archive a chat that another Codex app has open, so every merge needs a retry
